messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about parliamentary debate and Croatia in Croatia during the 2000s and 2010s and 2020s, matching this research need: cleaned corpus of Croatian Parliament debates from 2003–2020 with metadata on elected representatives and political parties, covering five full terms and over 500,000 speeches
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Croatian parliament debates corpus 2003 2020 five terms 500000 speeches dataset
Croatian parliamentary debates dataset 2003 2020 representatives political parties corpus
action.query: Croatian parliament debates corpus 2003 2020 five terms 500000 speeches dataset

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"CROCorp: Corpus of Parliamentary Debates in Croatia (v1.1.1, 2003–2020)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6521372","justification":"Exact match. Created by Michal Mochtak, Josip Glaurdić, and Christophe Lesschaeve (2022), this dataset provides a cleaned and preprocessed corpus of debates from the Croatian Parliament (Sabor) covering 2003–2020. It includes five complete parliamentary terms, over 500,000 speeches, and metadata on elected representatives and their political parties. Version 1.1.1 is available through Zenodo and directly satisfies all specified research requirements."},{"title":"CROCorp: Corpus of Parliamentary Debates in Croatia — Zenodo Dataset Record","url_or_doi":"https://zenodo.org/records/6521643","justification":"Official Zenodo landing page for CROCorp version 1.1.1. Provides access to the cleaned parliamentary debate corpus, accompanying metadata, documentation, and citation information. Covers Croatian parliamentary proceedings from 2003 through 2020, encompassing five complete terms and more than 500,000 speeches. This is an alternative access point for the exact-match dataset."},{"title":"CROCorp: Corpus of Parliamentary Debates in Croatia — GESIS Data Catalogue","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/SDN-10.7802-2388","justification":"GESIS research data catalogue entry documenting the CROCorp dataset. Confirms its coverage of Croatian parliamentary debates from 2003–2020, five complete parliamentary terms, more than 500,000 speeches, and associated metadata on parliamentary representatives and political parties. Useful for dataset discovery, verification, and research documentation."},{"title":"CROCorp: Corpus of Parliamentary Debates in Croatia — University of Luxembourg Research Repository","url_or_doi":"https://orbilu.uni.lu/handle/10993/58371","justification":"Institutional repository record maintained by the University of Luxembourg for CROCorp version 1.1.1, published in 2022. Documents the cleaned and preprocessed corpus of Croatian parliamentary debates spanning 2003–2020, including metadata about elected representatives and political parties. Provides access to the accompanying codebook and bibliographic information."},{"title":"ParlaCAP: Dataset for Tracking Political Agenda-Setting Across European Parliaments","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.23669/1ZTELP","justification":"Related multilingual parliamentary debate dataset that includes Croatia. Extends the ParlaMint parliamentary corpus by providing automatically classified speech topics and sentiment information. Useful for supplementary research on political agendas, parliamentary discourse, and party-level differences. Its scope extends beyond Croatia and the requested 2003–2020 period, so it is a complementary resource rather than an exact replacement for CROCorp."}]}
